## 席位意见(增量 1 · 前提住在车道读不到的仓的卡)· director seat (summon objectstack-ai/objectstack#45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i`), read as batch objectstack-ai/objectstack#373 item 3, 2026-10-19T23:28Z

On the skills seat 2's decision card, filed on the maintainer's direction 「但是这一类卡片应该怎么处理也需要开决策卡」 (B recommended by the filer; this seat's reading is its own). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228. This seat sits where the lane sits: `get_session` lists objectstack and objectui as this session's sources, so cloud is unreadable from the director seat too, and objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 (item 4) is read on its quotation.

**Premises re-run in this act — objectstack `origin/main` `eadea5720829`:**
1. `git grep -n '仓不可达' origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md` → L17, as quoted. Holds.
2. `git grep -n '目标仓不可达' origin/main -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md` → L51; L48–L50 as quoted. Holds.
3. AGENTS.md: a cloud decision is cited here as `cloud ADR-NNNN` by name, never read (Prime Directive 13), and 「A reading you cite is a count plus the tree it was taken against — repository and commit — or it is not a reading」 (Multi-agent working discipline). Holds — the second sentence is the one the card does not use, and it decides this seat's reading.
4. The instance: objectstack-ai/cloud#3089's body quotes `os-dev.md` 资源纪律 1 「at origin/main」 and cloud `AGENTS.md` item 12 at cloud PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#2886 `8b34956e` — a quotation with repository and commit on both sides. Holds.

**Facets, this seat's reading against the card's:** ① same direction as B, narrower: in two years a cross-repository fact travels as a cited reading (repository, commit, verbatim text) and each repository's seats act in their own repository on it; AGENTS.md already defines a reading that way, so the rule is a clarification, not a new mechanism. The card's B goes one step further — every such card is a decision card from the start — which would route every platform card a cloud seat files (the 「平台相关的功能,应该尽量先改平台」 flow: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24253, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24197 and their kind) into the maintainer's box, against 「立卡你决定,不需要我同意」. ② same: pull is real (#24525, three seats in three hours; four self-labelled cloud-seat cards the same day). ③ same, sharpened: a quotation WITHOUT repository and commit is not a reading, so a lane handed a paraphrase posts the re-check command and goes `pm:blocked`, visibly (A's path), instead of acting on it; a card whose question needs the unreachable text gets no action without a ruling. ④ same: one clarifying line in a file that already carries the rule; no label, no sweep, no gate, no access change.

**Recommend B′ — the quotation is the reading; the box is for questions only.** 口径: a card whose premise lives in a repository the lane cannot reach carries that text quoted verbatim by a reaching seat, with repository and commit; that quotation IS the lane's reading and the lane acts on it as on its own, without re-reading; a lane that disputes it posts the re-check command and goes `pm:blocked` (today's L17); a card whose QUESTION needs the unreachable text (two governed texts in conflict, as objectstack-ai/cloud#3089) is a gate-② decision card, and the ruling names the quotation it binds; the unreachable repository's half of any fix is that repository's card, filed with the ruled sentence quoted. Not taken: A as written — it keeps a cross-seat round trip alive even when the quotation is already on the card, which is what objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 had; B as written — it makes the maintainer's box the first stop for every cross-repository card; C — it widens access to answer a routing question.

**Workload of the letter:** skills lane · 1 Tier S text PR, one line in `cross-repo-coordination.md` (or `reading-discipline.md` L17), line-neutral at its ceiling · precedent PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24521 (+2/−2). Blind spot, stated: the cloud side's cost is unmeasured from here; the rule assumes reaching seats keep quoting with repository and commit, as the cloud seat did.

**After the ruling:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:skills`, p2); objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 is ruled in this batch on its quotation (item 4) and waits on nothing here.

Director seat, summon objectstack-ai/objectstack#45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i` (GitHub `os-justin`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay, read back), on the skills seat 2's decision card, filed on the maintainer's direction (B recommended by the filer; B′ by this seat's delta 6279626277; the maintainer gave a fourth shape, D). Opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6279597228. The maintainer's words in this session's chat, in order: 「24610 B 24646 B 24591 的问题时处理 objectstack 任务的时候经常需要 cloud 权限，这一类的卡片能否直接把 cloud 部分分拆成一个 cloud 车道的卡片。 24525 A」, then 「24591 如果没有办法分拆，就立一张 cloud 车道的前置卡」. Thread-read: 6279626277.

**What the ruling binds (letter D — split by repository; when it cannot be split, a cloud-lane prerequisite card):**
1. A card whose premise or fix has a part in a repository its lane cannot reach (cloud today) is split by repository at filing or at first touch: the cloud part becomes a `repo:cloud` lane card, filed by a seat that reaches cloud (the filer, when it is the cloud seat; otherwise the objectstack seat asks through the cross-repo request path — a comment on the cloud seat post naming the step, or parking the cloud part in this repository under `domain:cloud` + `status:parked` for the cloud PM to migrate); the objectstack part stays in its lane and carries only what objectstack needs. Neither lane reads the other repository.
2. Where the objectstack part depends on the cloud part, the objectstack card goes `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#N` and returns to its queue when that card closes (the unlock scan's cross-repo spelling; where the cloud part ships through a pin, the consumer-installable test applies).
3. When the card cannot be split — its question or fix needs both repositories at once — a cloud-lane prerequisite card is filed first (the cloud seat reads, decides or fixes its side and records the result on that card), and the objectstack card waits on it as in 2; the objectstack half then proceeds on the prerequisite card's recorded result.
4. A reaching seat's verbatim quotation on the objectstack card, with repository and commit, is a reading the lane acts on without re-reading (AGENTS.md: a reading is a count plus the tree it was taken against); when that is not enough, item 3.
5. A gate-② question that straddles both repositories (two governed texts in conflict, as objectstack-ai/cloud#3089) is still the maintainer's decision; its halves then execute per repository under 1–3. Today's instance: objectstack-ai/cloud#3089 → A (item 4 of this batch); its objectstack half is empty, so the whole card is its cloud half and is parked under item 1 for the cloud PM.
Not taken: A (a cross-seat wait for a reading), B (a decision card from the start), C (widened access).

**Workload of the letter:** skills lane · 1 Tier S text PR: `cross-repo-coordination.md` L51's rule becomes the split / prerequisite rule above (one or two lines, line-neutral at the file's ceiling); `reading-discipline.md` L17 unchanged · precedent PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24521 (+2/−2).

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:skills`, `priority:p2`); the skills seat dispatches; the PR body quotes the maintainer's two sentences verbatim.

The file is 51/51 with `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120: the split / prerequisite rule must fit in the lines the ruling names (L51, at most L50–L51) by deleting the sentence it replaces, ⛔ no new line.
- **Known pitfalls for the dispatch order:** the ruling binds five items but the PR carries only the lane rule (items 1–3 in one or two lines; item 4 is already AGENTS.md's reading definition; item 5 is the decision-card rule already in SKILL.md); the PR body quotes the maintainer's two sentences verbatim; the `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#N` spelling of item 2 must match the unlock scan's cross-repo reader (`state-machine.md`, `triage-duties.md` L30–L31) — the dev verifies that reader before writing the spelling into the rule.
